lines.text: Abram goes up out of Egypt into the Negev with Lot, then returns to the altar between Bethel and Ai.
The land cannot support Abram and Lot together, so discord breaks out between their herdsmen.
Abram tells Lot they are kinsmen and offers that if Lot goes left, Abram will go left.

wrong_details.true: I will go to the right

lines.text: Lot chooses the well-watered plain of the Jordan, heads west, and pitches his tent toward Sodom.
The LORD promises Abram all the land and offspring like the dust, and Abram builds an altar at Hebron.
